semantics.source: problem.txt: Moore transition table and synchronous active high reset; all sequential logic on positive clock edge
semantics.reset: reset=1 at posedge overrides input and sets state A; changes between edges do not reset state
semantics.sampling: out reflects current registered state, including new state after positive-edge nonblocking updates
semantics.initialization: No initial state specified; verification asserts reset before expecting defined output

numeric.port_widths: All ports one bit per original interface
numeric.encoding: Internal two-bit encoding is implementation choice; no arithmetic

verification.oracle: Independent table-based model from original transition table
checks: Every transition from each state for both binary input values
Reset from every state for both input values
Reset is synchronous and has priority
Output unchanged by input/reset changes between clock edges
verification.sampling: Check settled output before rising edge and one time unit after rising edge
verification.termination: Fatal on any mismatch, bounded timeout, PASS only after all checks

specification_ambiguities.issue: Power-up state and behavior for unknown input/reset are unspecified
specification_ambiguities.resolution: No initialization added; checks start after synchronous reset and drive binary inputs/reset
